name: Panoptes
description: Global-scale Python-based network telemetry ecosystem implementing discovery, enrichment and polling with plugin architecture and horizontal scalability.

docker_support.docker_evidence: You can try out Panoptes in a Docker container. panoptes_docker includes Python3.6, redis, zookeeper, influxdb.

eval_notes: Yahoo's production network telemetry system. Plugin architecture makes it interesting for evaluations involving custom telemetry collection extensions.
